class.name: FellowFootsteps3D
class.brief_description: A character's footsteps synthesised from its feet as drawn and what they land on: no animation events, no samples.
class.description: Milestone 181 ([code]docs/decisions/0323-footsteps.md[/code]). Put it last among a character's [Skeleton3D] modifiers (after [FellowFootLock3D] and [FellowFootPlacement3D]): it reads each sole's heel and ball (the points [FellowFootLock3D] uses) against the ground under the foot — a ray down through it, the character's own body left out — every time the pose changes. A foot is down when its lower point is within [member contact_height] of the ground and planted (slower than 0.6 m/s across it); up again when both points rise 2 cm higher or are swept away (1.2 m/s). Touching down is a step at the speed the point came down; the other point coming down after is the sole rolling onto it; leaving, the toe lifts; a foot moving across the ground while down scuffs. What it stands on: the ray's collider's [FellowContactSound3D] ([member FellowContactSound3D.surface], or its material: wood a wooden floor, metal a steel deck, stone, glass, plastic and ceramic tiles, rubber a mat), its [code]fellow_surface[/code] metadata (a ground's name — "gravel", "snow", ... — or number), a [FellowTerrain3D]'s layers there by their weights ([member FellowTerrainLayer.surface]; the two strongest mixed), else [member default_ground]; water over the ground there (a [FellowWater3D]) makes it water. The sound, synthesised on the audio thread and placed at the feet: on hard ground the sole's contact (a half-sine of force as long as the [member shoe] takes to compress) through the shoe's and the floor's resonances, its click and the weight's thump; on loose ground grains crushed at a rate with the step's energy (Cook's PhISEM), each a click through the material's resonances, over the ground's compression; mud's squelch and suction, water's splash and drips (bubbles); scuffs (a sneaker squeaks on wood or tiles). A step's strength goes with the sole's speed and the root of [member body_mass]. The [signal footstep] signal is a game's (guards hearing, tracks in snow, dust); it is sent whether or not the sound is heard.

method.name: debug_render
method.description: Footsteps synthesised offline (tests and tuning, [code]benchmarks/tools/world_sound/footstep_sound.gd[/code]): [param events] by time, each a [Dictionary] — [code]{time, part: "heel", "ball" or "lift", ground (a [enum Ground] or a name), ground2 and weight2 (a second ground and its share), shoe, speed (m/s), load (kg)}[/code] or [code]{time, part: "scuff", ground, shoe, speed}[/code] (speed 0 ends it). Returns [code]samples[/code] (interleaved stereo, the same in both), [code]strikes[/code], [code]grains[/code], [code]bubbles[/code] and [code]usec_per_second[/code].

method.name: get_foot_state
method.description: A foot ([param foot]: 0 left, 1 right) as last seen: [code]down[/code], [code]heel_height[/code] and [code]ball_height[/code] (metres over the ground under it), [code]heel_sweep[/code] and [code]ball_sweep[/code] (m/s across it), [code]ground[/code], [code]ground2[/code] and [code]weight2[/code] (a terrain's mix).

method.name: get_ground
method.description: What [param foot] (0 left, 1 right) last stood on (a [enum Ground]).

method.name: get_sound_stats
method.description: [code]playing[/code], [code]steps[/code] and [code]lifts[/code] found, [code]scuff_seconds[/code], the last [code]ground[/code], the synthesis's [code]strikes[/code], [code]grains[/code], [code]bubbles[/code] and [code]peak[/code], [code]mixed_seconds[/code] and [code]mix_usec_per_second[/code].

members.member: The character's mass (kg): a step's strength goes with its root.
What the ray under each foot finds the ground in.
A foot is down when its lower point comes this close to the ground (metres) and is planted. Motion capture's soles often stand a few centimetres up (CMU's 3-5 cm: 0.05).
The ground when the collider says nothing of its own.
How far behind the ankle the heel's point is (metres), as [member FellowFootLock3D.heel_offset].
The left toes' bone (the ball of the foot); none: the heel alone.
What the character wears: the sole's contact (a sneaker's 2 ms, a boot's 1, a hard heel's 0.35: its click, bare feet 3 ms), its resonance, the squeak.
The audio bus the footsteps play on.
The footsteps are heard (the [signal footstep] signal is sent either way).
Beyond this distance from the listener the footsteps are not heard (their voice stops).
The distance (metres) at which the footsteps are heard at the level synthesised (3: a third-person camera's); nearer louder, farther quieter ([member AudioStreamPlayer3D.unit_size]).

signal.name: footstep
signal.description: A foot touching down: which ([param foot]: 0 left, 1 right), where (world), on what ([param ground], a [enum Ground]), how fast it came down (m/s).

constants.constant: Stone, concrete: the sole's contact alone.
A wooden floor: its boards boom.
Snow: crunching lower (0.9-4 kHz), a soft thump.
Dirt: a dull thump, a few grains.
Mud: a squelch, a suck as the toe lifts.
Soft rubber: a dull step; squeaks on smooth floors.
A hard heel (leather, wood): a click.
